subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

A compass is an important tool in navigation.

P: It always points towards the magnetic north.

Q: Even in cloudy weather, it shows direction.

R: It does not depend on GPS or electricity.

S: Hikers and sailors rely on it during travel.

6. Thus, it remains a reliable tool even today.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing the importance of the compass as a navigation tool and ends by highlighting its reliability.
 
• **Sentence S comes first** as it introduces the users of the compass:
 
 
• "Hikers and sailors rely on it during travel."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as it explains why the compass is independent of modern technology:
 
 
• "It does not depend on GPS or electricity."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P comes next** as it explains the compass's key feature:
 
 
• "It always points towards the magnetic north."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q comes last** as it emphasizes its utility in challenging conditions:
 
 
• "Even in cloudy weather, it shows direction."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **SRPQ**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"A compass is an important tool in navigation. Hikers and sailors rely on it during travel. It does not depend on GPS or electricity. It always points towards the magnetic north. Even in cloudy weather, it shows direction. Thus, it remains a reliable tool even today."
